description: Fig. 4 is a composite TEM figure on κ-carbides in a Fe-Mn-Al-C austenitic low-density steel: five of the six caption-described panels are supplied and they alternate between electron diffraction and dark-field (DF) imaging. (b) and (c) are SAED patterns labelled "Zone = [1 0 0]" with a "5 1/nm" reciprocal-space scale bar; each shows an array of strong reflections annotated "(0 0 1)" and "(0 1 0)" plus two fainter spots enclosed by white circles. (d), (e) and (f) are dark-field images recorded with the superlattice reflection, each with a 30 nm scale bar, showing fine bright speckle (nano-sized particles) dispersed in a dark matrix; (d) additionally shows a dark banded feature crossing the field and (e) a diffuse brighter patch, while (f) is the most uniform speckle field. Per the caption the pairings are (b, e) = HR68, (c, f) = HR82 and (d) = HR45, with panel (a) (HR45 SAED) not present in the supplied set. Together the panels show that faint superlattice reflections and the matching dark-field contrast arise from homogeneously dispersed nano-sized κ-carbides in all three hot-rolled conditions. No size or volume-fraction numbers are printed on any panel.

observations.observation: Panels (b) and (c) are SAED patterns printed with the text 'Zone = [1 0 0]' and a '5 1/nm' reciprocal-space scale bar, and are annotated with the indices (0 0 1) and (0 1 0) on strong reflections.
In both (b) and (c) two fainter extra spots are enclosed by white circles, marking superlattice reflections in addition to the strong matrix reflections.
Panels (d), (e) and (f) are dark-field TEM images, each with a 30 nm scale bar, showing bright speckle contrast (nano-sized particles) dispersed in a dark matrix rather than continuous grains.

Panel (d) contains a dark banded/linear feature crossing the speckled field; panel (e) shows an additional diffuse brighter patch; panel (f) shows the most homogeneous speckle field of the three dark-field images.
Panel (a), described in the caption as the HR45 SAED pattern, is missing from the supplied image set, so only two of the three SAED patterns and all three dark-field images could be inspected.

The caption states that (a-c) are SAED patterns taken from the austenite matrix of the (a, d) HR45, (b, e) HR68 and (c, f) HR82 samples along the [1 0 0] zone axis, and that (d-f) are the corresponding dark-field images formed with the (1 0 0) superlattice diffraction from the same areas.
The caption states that the faint superlattice diffraction spot marked with circles indicates the presence of κ-carbides.
The citing text states that the faint (1 0 0) and (1 0 1) superlattice reflections indicate a second phase with an ordered crystal structure.

The citing text states that the dark-field images demonstrate a large number of nano-sized particles homogeneously precipitated inside the austenite grains during water quenching in all three samples, identified as (Fe,Mn)AlC-type κ-carbides with an L′12-type structure formed by spinodal decomposition and ordering during fast cooling without aging.
The citing text reports mean κ-carbide sizes of 0.81 ± 0.26 nm, 0.78 ± 0.17 nm and 0.83 ± 0.23 nm for the HR45, HR68 and HR82 samples respectively; these values are not printed on the figure panels.

The citing text reports κ-carbide volume fractions of 3.5 ± 0.33%, 3.3 ± 0.52% and 3.9 ± 0.39% for the HR45, HR68 and HR82 samples respectively, attributing the weak diffraction spots to these low volume fractions.

The citing text states that increasing hot-rolling reduction from 45% to 82% raised UTS from 861 ± 11 MPa to 976 ± 11 MPa and YS from 480 ± 10 MPa to 648 ± 13 MPa, with κ-carbides contributing precipitate strengthening alongside (Nb,Mo,W)C particles.

subfigures.description: Not supplied in the image set. The caption states it is the SAED pattern of the austenite matrix of sample HR45 along the [1 0 0] zone axis.

SAED pattern, dark background with a square-like array of strong bright spots; printed labels (0 0 1) and (0 1 0), text 'Zone = [1 0 0]' and a '5 1/nm' scale bar. Two faint spots near the strong reflections are circled in white. Caption assigns this pattern to sample HR68.

SAED pattern of the same kind as (b), slightly more diffuse/blurred: same strong-spot array, printed labels (0 0 1) and (0 1 0), 'Zone = [1 0 0]' and a '5 1/nm' scale bar, with two white circles marking faint superlattice spots. Caption assigns this pattern to sample HR82.

Dark-field TEM image (30 nm scale bar) dominated by fine bright speckle on a dark matrix, i.e. nano-sized particles; a dark banded/linear feature runs across the middle of the field. Caption assigns this image to sample HR45.

Dark-field TEM image (30 nm scale bar) of speckled bright nano-particles in a dark matrix, with a diffuse brighter particle-rich patch near the centre and faint dark banding. Caption assigns this image to sample HR68.

Dark-field TEM image (30 nm scale bar) showing the most uniform and dense field of fine bright speckles (nano-particles) distributed homogeneously in the dark matrix. Caption assigns this image to sample HR82.

unreadable_items: panel (a) (HR45 SAED pattern per the caption) is not included in the supplied image set
individual κ-carbide particle sizes and number densities cannot be resolved or measured from the dark-field panels (d-f) at the supplied resolution; they are only quoted in the citing text
the exact crystallographic indices of the two circled faint spots cannot be read from the pixels — only the (0 0 1) and (0 1 0) labels on the adjacent strong spots are legible
